title: 第5章 湖人的邀请第6章 同居俏佳人
content_zh:
第五章 湖人的邀请
叶锋询问了拜纳姆有没有加盟湖人的可能性。
拜纳姆很实在，问什么就答什么。他觉得这很有可能，不过有点冒险，叶锋的投篮实在太烂了，进攻区域就只有篮下，还必须是面筐，不会背身。这样是很难获得保障合同的。唯一可以信赖的是他的防守，一对一防守中他的力量会让很多内线球员感到难受，对方如果使用挡拆配合，换防后叶锋的速度也肯定能跟上大部分后卫，只要锻炼上一段时间，协防能力肯定也差不了。
叶锋也知道纯粹的防守型球员很难获得高薪，不过他现在更倾向于非选秀进入NBA，他准备进入联盟后再慢慢提高进攻水准。加入UCLA篮球队锻炼一年，受到更多关注后参加选秀自然稳妥，但那要耽误一年时间，最重要的是如果参加选秀，他就很难进湖人队了。和很多过早加入NBA的年轻球员不同，他不是经不起金钱的诱惑，而是想抱大腿，拿冠军戒指。金钱方面他不太在意，哪怕是签底薪，也会有几十万美元。这对穷惯了他来说已经是很大一笔钱了。
参加选秀就算是首轮又如何？万一被选去了森林狼，猛龙那样的苦寒之地不是要郁闷死？叶锋下定了决心，又问道：“安猪，你能像制服组推荐我吗？如果参加季前赛，我希望能在湖人试试。”（拜纳姆的英文名叫Andrew，翻译成中文是“安德鲁”，但是英文发音dr发“zh”的音。所以“Andrew”英文念着像“安猪”。中国球迷都喜欢这么称呼他。）
拜纳姆大笑道：“你还真想改打篮球啊？如果你签约湖人，我们可就是队友了。这太棒了，我找球探来看看你还是没问题的。我觉得你强过米姆，很可能留下的。”
叶锋知道他说的是谁，克里斯.米姆，身高213CM，在德克萨斯大学打球期间创造了学校的盖帽纪录，总篮板数、两双场次都在德克萨斯大学历史上排名第二，还在大三时入选了全美第一阵容。他不是个弱者，2000年第一轮第7位被公牛队选中，马上交易到了骑士。倒霉的是，他生涯第一个赛季就伤了三次，后来也伤病不断。2004年转会到湖人，在湖人的头两个赛季他都是首发，第二个赛季场均10.2分，50%的命中率。他本来是挺有实力的角色球员，但是去年他因为右脚踝手术赛季报销。这赛季米姆已经是自由球员了，状态如何是个未知数。湖人很有可能签他，他是叶锋的主要竞争对手。
想到米姆伤后已经临近退役，叶锋也有了点底气，笑道：“你帮我问问吧。如果进NBA的话，我只想在洛杉矶打球，去别的地方不开心。要是不行，我就回学校加入篮球队锻炼一年参加选秀，总之我准备改打篮球了。”
拜纳姆很兴奋，立即拿出了电话。“好，我这就帮你问，可你怎么突然就想打篮球了呢？”
叶锋早就想好了理由。“因为篮球比赛是在室内，我现在对室外球场有点阴影，万一哪天再被雷劈一次，可就不一定能醒过来了。”
“……”拜纳姆对这个理由有些无语，他很佩服叶锋超人的身体素质，马上给湖人球探打了电话。
湖人并不缺少内线球员。中锋有拜纳姆、夸梅.布朗、米姆；大前锋位置上有奥多姆、图里亚夫，布莱恩.库克，要想获得出场时间，竞争非常激烈。叶锋还知道中期湖人会和灰熊交易，引进保罗.加索尔，这位全明星大前锋一来，他就更难获得出场机会了。但他必须要试一试，进了湖人，说不定第一个赛季就能战胜凯尔特人赢得总冠军呢！
第二天，湖人队派出了他们最好的球探。那是一位身穿红色连衣裙，拥有令人喷鼻血魔鬼身材的大美女，她的名字叫邦妮.吉尔.拉芙林。
拉芙林出生于1976年，父亲拥有德国和爱尔兰血统，母亲则身具阿帕切人、西班牙和夏威夷血统，属于超级混血。他的父亲是NBA著名保镖，也是湖人老板杰里巴斯的密友，巴斯更是将拉芙林看作自己的女儿一样。拉芙林曾做过洛杉矶湖人队拉拉队长，出演过影视剧，不但是球探，也是娱乐明星。
NBA老板们都希望提高球队商业价值，叶锋是橄榄球员改打篮球，是很不错的噱头。而且他是华人，华人是很吸引眼球的，否则湖人也不会在选秀大会40顺位选中孙悦，孙悦在中国的受关注程度远不如易建联和姚明，但如果队伍里有两个华人，湖人就有可能成为中国的主场了。
拉芙林走到叶锋面前，和他握了握手，笑道：“嗨，我是邦妮.吉尔.拉芙林，湖人队的球探，很高兴见到你。”
“很高兴见到你，拉芙林小姐，我不得不说，你真人比在电视、杂志上看更漂亮！”叶锋赞叹道。
“真的？谢谢。”美国女人很喜欢被称赞，像“你身材好辣”这种话，没人会感到反感。
拉芙林并不是湖人队的花瓶，她的办事效率很高，没聊几句就进入了正题，对叶锋进行了一次完整的体侧。每测完一项，她几乎都要说上一句——“OH，MYGOD！”
叶锋身高201cm，穿鞋身高203cm，臂展达到214cm，体重108公斤，全身脂肪含量仅占6.2%，原地摸高273cm，垂直弹跳85cm，最大弹跳92cm。

以上还都是小儿科，3/4场地冲刺跑他用时3.15秒，折返灵敏测试10秒87，这样的数据即使和詹姆斯相比也毫不逊色。NBA卧推标准是84公斤，看次数。这个重量对叶锋来说太小儿科，他换180公斤推了7次。
拉芙林毫不犹豫的在表格上给叶锋评价为S+，这在球员评定中属于潜力无限型。抛开球技不说，叶锋的身体太棒了，她简直不敢相信这是中国人的体侧数据。当问到血统问题时，叶锋却没法回答，他自己也不知道。
拉芙林马上向湖人总经理米奇.库普切克报告了情况，湖人队制服组决定邀请叶锋参加季前赛训练营，代表湖人打季前赛赛。而且他是有很大的机会留下的，没人会轻易放弃一个身体素质堪比状元的人。
叶锋痛快的答应了湖人的邀请，同时拒绝了参加老鹰训练营的提议。扎萨纳并不是老鹰队的人，所以他并不为此感到失望，祝福了叶锋，并支持他的选择。
体侧做完后，拉芙林看叶锋的眼神都变了。“天啊，你也许是身体素质最好的中国人，易建联也不错，但你的综合素质比他更强。我想如果公布体侧数据的话，你肯定能获得更多的关注。”
拜纳姆觉得自己就像传说中的伯乐，双手抱胸得意道：“我就说他很厉害吧。”
拉芙林笑道：“安德鲁，你应该庆幸他的身高只有201CM，不是210CM，不然制服组就要让他代替你了。”
“……”拜纳姆这才想起叶锋似乎也能打5号位，可能要减少他的出场时间了。
接下来除了帮拜纳姆训练，叶锋也加强了篮球基础训练。拜纳姆练习罚篮、投篮的时候他不再帮忙传球，而是在一旁拍球，熟悉运球的感觉。投篮方面他虽然命中率低，至少动作还标准，带球就真是一塌糊涂了。不要说过人，他连带球围着球场跑都做不利落，过人的假动作他更一窍不通。他拜师拜纳姆，学了几招低位转身技术，和挤住对方篮下投篮，才算多了点进攻手段。
对此拜纳姆有些无奈，他感觉自己更像陪练。叶锋很会做人，天天晚上请拜纳姆吃饭聊天，增进友谊。想到叶锋进步快是因为起点低，拜纳姆也就心理平衡了。
拜纳姆也有进步，他打的更硬朗了。两人在篮下肉搏，肌肉几乎撞出火星来。扎萨纳称他们训练时的对抗都像季后赛。
有一天，湖人总经理库普切克亲自到训练场看了叶锋和拜纳姆练球，他也比较看好叶锋，感觉比另一名中国球员孙悦强。
站在二楼窗口，库普切克问拉芙林：“你觉得他适合打什么位置？出任内线是不是矮了些？”
拉芙林想了想，说道：“他的进攻太差，暂时只能打内线，防守端是没有问题的，我想联盟里除了奥尼尔，没有他扛不住的人。黄金时期的科比也比不上他的身体素质。如果他的协防意识够好，将来应该可以成为球星，这次我们捡到宝了。”
库普切克笑道：“也别高兴的太早，只是有可能而已。当年我们选中的韦弗素质也很好，可那人除了突破什么也不会，我感觉球商比身体素质更重要，拉里.伯德不就跳不起来吗？等训练营开始好好观察他吧，如果他可以适应节奏，就留下他。”
8月，叶锋要代表湖人参加季前赛的消息一传出，顿时引发了轩然大波。各大媒体更加关注他，和其他中国球员相比，他是一个神秘的人。
叶锋的橄榄球队友看到新闻，也纷纷打电话询问情况，托巴还劝他回去打橄榄球。在UCLA，叶锋是球队很重要的一员。
叶锋用想好的借口打发了这些人，他要打篮球！

Chapter 5 Invitation from the Lakers
Ye Feng asked about the possibility of Bynum joining the Lakers.
Bynum is very down-to-earth and answers whatever is asked. He thinks this is very possible, but it is a bit risky. Ye Feng's shooting is really bad. The only offensive area is the basket, and he must face the basket and not post up. This makes it difficult to obtain a guaranteed contract. The only thing that can be relied on is his defense. In one-on-one defense, his strength will make many inside players feel uncomfortable. If the opponent uses pick-and-roll cooperation, Ye Feng's speed will definitely be able to keep up with most defenders after switching defenses. As long as he exercises for a period of time, his defensive ability will definitely be the same.
Ye Feng also knows that it is difficult for purely defensive players to obtain high salaries, but he is now more inclined to enter the NBA without the draft. He plans to slowly improve his offensive level after entering the league. It is natural to join the UCLA basketball team to train for a year, and then participate in the draft after receiving more attention, but it will delay one year. The most important thing is that if he participates in the draft, it will be difficult for him to enter the Lakers. Unlike many young players who join the NBA prematurely, it's not that he can't withstand the temptation of money, but that he wants to hug his thighs and get a championship ring. He doesn't care much about money. Even if he signs for a minimum salary, he will still have hundreds of thousands of dollars. This was already a lot of money for him who was used to being poor.
So what if it’s the first round of the draft? If he was selected to the Timberwolves, wouldn't he be depressed to death in a bitter cold place like the Raptors? Ye Feng made up his mind and asked again: "Anzhu, can you recommend me to the front office? If I participate in the preseason, I hope to try with the Lakers." (Bynum's English name is Andrew, which is translated into Chinese as "Andrew", but the English pronunciation dr is pronounced as "zh". So "Andrew" is pronounced like "Anzhu" in English. Chinese fans like to call him this.)
Bynum laughed and said, "Do you really want to switch to basketball? If you sign with the Lakers, we will be teammates. This is great. I will ask a scout to check you out. It will be fine. I think you are better than Mihm and you are likely to stay."
Ye Feng knew who he was talking about. Chris Mihm, 213cm tall, set the school's block record while playing at the University of Texas. He ranked second in the history of the University of Texas in total rebounds and double-doubles. He was also selected to the All-American first team as a junior. He is not a weakling. He was selected by the Bulls with the seventh pick in the first round of 2000 and was immediately traded to the Cavaliers. Unfortunately, he was injured three times in the first season of his career, and he continued to suffer injuries later on. He moved to the Lakers in 2004. He was a starter in the first two seasons with the Lakers. In his second season, he averaged 10.2 points per game and shot 50% from the field. He was originally a very capable role player, but last year he was out for the season due to right ankle surgery. Mihm is already a free agent this season, and his status is unknown. The Lakers are very likely to sign him, and he is Ye Feng's main competitor.
Thinking that Mim was approaching retirement after his injury, Ye Feng gained some confidence and said with a smile: "Ask me. If I get into the NBA, I just want to play in Los Angeles. I won't be happy elsewhere. If that doesn't work, I will go back to school and join the basketball team to train for a year to participate in the draft. In short, I am planning to switch to basketball."
Bynum was very excited and immediately took out his phone. "Okay, I'll ask it for you, but why do you suddenly want to play basketball?"
Ye Feng had already thought of the reason. "Because the basketball game is indoors, I am a little worried about the outdoor court now. If I am struck by lightning again one day, I may not be able to wake up."
"..." Bynum was speechless at this reason. He admired Ye Feng's superhuman physical fitness and immediately called the Lakers scouts.
The Lakers have no shortage of inside players. The centers include Bynum, Kwame Brown, and Mihm; the power forward positions include Odom, Turiaf, and Bryan..Cook, competition for playing time is fierce. Ye Feng also knew that the Lakers would trade with the Grizzlies in the mid-term to bring in Pau Gasol. Once the All-Star power forward arrives, it will be even harder for him to get a chance to play. But he has to give it a try. If he joins the Lakers, maybe he can defeat the Celtics and win the championship in his first season!
The next day, the Lakers sent out their best scouts. It was a beautiful woman wearing a red dress with a figure that made people nosebleed. Her name was Bonnie Jill Laughlin.
Laughlin was born in 1976. Her father is of German and Irish descent, and her mother is of Apache, Spanish and Hawaiian descent. She is a super mixed race. His father is a famous NBA bodyguard and a close friend of Lakers owner Jerry Buss. Buss treats Laughlin as his own daughter. Laughlin was a cheerleader for the Los Angeles Lakers and appeared in movies and TV shows. He was not only a scout, but also an entertainment star.
NBA bosses all hope to increase the commercial value of their teams. Ye Feng is a football player who switched to basketball, which is a very good gimmick. And he is Chinese, and Chinese are very eye-catching, otherwise the Lakers would not have selected Sun Yue with the 40th pick in the draft. Sun Yue is far less popular in China than Yi Jianlian and Yao Ming, but if there are two Chinese in the team, the Lakers may become China's home court.
Laughlin walked up to Ye Feng, shook hands with him, and said with a smile: "Hi, I'm Bonnie Jill Laughlin, a scout from the Lakers. Nice to meet you."
"Nice to meet you, Miss Laughlin, I have to say, you are more beautiful in person than on TV or in magazines!" Ye Feng praised.
"Really? Thank you." American women like to be complimented very much. No one will be offended by words like "You have such a hot figure."
Laughlin is not a star of the Lakers. She works very efficiently. She got to the point without a few words of conversation and gave Ye Feng a complete body scan. After every test, she almost always said, "OH, MYGOD!"
Ye Feng is 201cm tall, 203cm tall when wearing shoes, has a wingspan of 214cm, weighs 108kg, has only 6.2% body fat, reaches a height of 273cm, has a vertical jump of 85cm, and a maximum jump of 92cm.
The above is all childish. It took him 3.15 seconds to sprint 3/4 of the field, and 10 seconds for the reentry sensitivity test. Such data is not inferior even when compared with James. The NBA bench press standard is 84 kilograms, depending on the number of times. This weight was too childish for Ye Feng, so he pushed 7 times at 180 kilograms.
Laughlin did not hesitate to rate Ye Feng as S+ on the form, which is considered a player with unlimited potential. Putting aside his skills, Ye Feng's body is so good that she can't believe that these are the body statistics of a Chinese. When asked about the bloodline question, Ye Feng couldn't answer it, and he didn't know it himself.
Laughlin immediately reported the situation to Lakers general manager Mitch Kupchak, and the Lakers uniform staff decided to invite Ye Feng to participate in the preseason training camp and play preseason games on behalf of the Lakers. And he has a great chance to stay. No one will give up easily on a person whose physical fitness is comparable to the number one pick.
Ye Feng readily agreed to the Lakers' invitation, while rejecting the offer to attend the Hawks training camp. Zasana was not from the Eagles, so he was not disappointed, blessed Ye Feng and supported his choice.
After finishing the side body massage, Laughlin's eyes changed when she looked at Ye Feng. "Oh my god, you may be the Chinese with the best physical fitness. Yi Jianlian is also good, but your overall fitness is better than him. I think if the body side data is released, you will definitely get more attention."
Bynum felt like the legendary Bole, crossed his arms and proudly said: "Let me just say he is very powerful."
Laughlin laughed.: "Andrew, you should be lucky that his height is only 201cm, not 210cm, otherwise the uniform staff would have asked him to replace you."
"..." Bynum then remembered that Ye Feng seemed to be able to play the No. 5 position, and his playing time might have to be reduced.
Next, in addition to helping Bynum train, Ye Feng also strengthened basic basketball training. When Bynum practiced free throws and shooting, he no longer helped pass the ball, but patted the ball aside to familiarize himself with the feeling of dribbling. Although his shooting percentage is low, at least his movements are standard, but his dribbling is a mess. Don't talk about others, he can't even run around the court with the ball smoothly, and he doesn't know anything about the fake moves of passing people. He studied under Bynum and learned a few low-post turning techniques and squeezing the opponent's basket to shoot, which gave him more offensive methods.
Bynum was a little helpless about this. He felt more like a sparring partner. Ye Feng is a good person. He invites Bynum to dinner and chat every night to enhance friendship. Thinking that Ye Feng's rapid progress was due to his low starting point, Bynum felt mentally balanced.
Bynum has also improved, and he is playing tougher. The two were fighting hand-to-hand under the basket, and their muscles almost exploded with sparks. Zasana said their practices were like playoff games.
One day, Lakers general manager Kupchak personally went to the training ground to watch Ye Feng and Bynum practice. He was also more optimistic about Ye Feng and felt that he was better than another Chinese player Sun Yue.
Standing at the window on the second floor, Kupchak asked Laughlin: "What position do you think he is suitable for? Is he too short to be an inside man?"
Laughlin thought for a while and said: "His offense is too bad. He can only play inside for the time being. There is no problem on the defensive end. I think there is no one in the league except O'Neal who he can't handle. Kobe Bryant in his prime period can't compare to his physical fitness. If his awareness of help defense is good enough, he should be able to become a star in the future. This time we found a treasure."
Kupchak smiled and said: "Don't be too happy, it's just a possibility. The quality of Weaver we selected back then was also very good, but he could do nothing but break through. I feel that golf intelligence is more important than physical fitness. Isn't Larry Bird unable to jump? Let's observe him carefully when the training camp starts. If he can adapt to the rhythm, keep him."
In August, as soon as the news came out that Ye Feng would represent the Lakers in the preseason, it immediately caused an uproar. The major media pay more attention to him. Compared with other Chinese players, he is a mysterious person.
Ye Feng's rugby teammates saw the news and called to inquire about the situation. Toba also persuaded him to go back to play rugby. At UCLA, Ye Feng is a very important member of the team.
Ye Feng dismissed these people with an excuse he thought of: he wanted to play basketball!
